positions.title: Senior Full Stack Developer (eCommerce)
positions.description:
Accomplishment:
Modernized ShopCGX's patron validation services infrastructure. This included:
- Migrating from PHP to a BunJS project written in TypeScript
- Migration of infrastructure to Azure via use of containerization, Azure App Services, and Terraform (to be able to replicate the infrastructure)
- Modernization of DevOps through use of unit testing, container registries, and use of Azure Deployment slots to ensure zero downtime

Duties:
Builds frontend customizations (TypeScript, Liquid) and backend applications (C#, TypeScript) to automate eCommerce processes for ShopCGX staff and customers. Collaborates with other developers via stand-up meetings, team programming, and code reviews. Mentors entry-level developers to ensure proper programming and deployment techniques are used for efficiency. Provides application support for Headquarters and Store staff on a HelpDesk rotation.

projects.title: Silent Auction Web Application for the USCG CSC Morale Committee
projects.description: The USCG CSC merchandising team gathers countless samples of goods that would've been wasteful to dispose of or simple give away, so a previous morale committee decided to start auctioning off the sample merchandise. It was a manual process at first. Then after a couple of years, an auction application was made. The first iteration of the application was awesome, but it was only usable on Windows computers, leaving our Mac-using marketing team unable to participate without borrowing a Windows machine or bidding manually (using pen-and-paper). When I eventually joined the CSC morale committee, I took the initiative to make a hosted web-version of the auction application.
